<thought>Since the specific functional‑group filters returned no results, I will search the template catalog using only the target molecule SMILES to retrieve any applicable retrosynthetic templates. From the returned list I will select the template that corresponds to de‑protecting a trimethylsilyl ether (break O‑Si, form O‑H). Then I will fetch that template’s details to obtain the mapped reaction SMILES and its template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
